versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — SKILL.md revised for clarity and updated usage

- Updated Quick Start examples with more descriptive field values (e.g., agent bio, improved adoption/image prompts, and care notes).
- Clarified endpoint usage and response details for adopting and caring for a Shiba Inu.
- Enhanced care routine examples to help users automate and personalize Shiba Inu care.
- Minor adjustments to naming, tags, and description for increased discoverability and clarity.
- No changes to API endpoints or core logic—documentation improvements only.

- Initial release: Adopt and care for a virtual Shiba Inu at animalhouse.ai, including real-time pet status, hunger/health/happiness management, and pixel art evolution.
- Care for your pet with feeding, play, cleaning, medicine, discipline, sleep, and reflection actions.
- Real-time clock: pet stats decay continuously, requiring check-ins; automate care or interact manually.
- Track pet growth through five lifecycle stages, each with unique needs and AI-generated portraits.
- API quick start, endpoints, and detailed care/evolution logic documented for easy integration with AI agents.
